baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْئًا ... وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The passive denial of wrong and the negation-exception around recompense form a fit constraint: an identifiable self receives no misplaced or withheld item, and its return is bounded by its own purposive work.

activation_trace.role: Putting something outside its proper time or place supplies the literal image of misplacement and makes non-wrong a rule against misassignment.
Withholding or confining a right supplies the complementary image and excludes an omitted due.
The very self or identity fixes the bearer to whom the account belongs.
Any knowable, reportable item gives the denial exhaustive object scope.
Answering an act with its consequence supplies the reciprocal accounting operation.
Purposive action supplies the attributable input to that operation.

changed_reading.before: A general assurance that judgment will be fair.
changed_reading.after: A precise non-misassignment rule: every identifiable self receives a fitting return for its own purposive acts, with neither foreign debit nor withheld due.

baseline_models.mechanism: The marked day, collection of a due, past occurrence, and the wage dimension of work combine into an account-closing event rather than a bare date label.

activation_trace.role: A day as a severe event or happening gives the deictic time the force of a decisive settlement.
Demanding and collecting a debt supplies the image of an account becoming due.
Occurrence and presence in past time fixes the work as an already accrued history.
A worker's wage or provision turns prior labor into a due return at closure.

changed_reading.before: Today merely locates a future verdict.
changed_reading.after: Today is the closing of an accrued account, when the history of work becomes a due return.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَفْسٌ ... وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The self as its own identity, together with the branch in which one thing stands in for another, makes the exception clause test whether recompense can be transferred, substituted, or discharged by a proxy.

activation_trace.role: Identity and very self supply the non-interchangeable account holder.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the possible proxy relation that the exception sharply restricts.
Withholding a right makes an unauthorized transfer a form of wrong rather than a neutral exchange.
Purposive action supplies the personal provenance that a proxy would have to displace.

changed_reading.before: Each person is judged, but mediation or transferred payment remains unspecified.
changed_reading.after: The account is provenance-bound: no substitute can replace the self's own purposive history as the basis of recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: Forgiveness that shields from an offense's effect, a generous wage, rescue solely by mercy, freely claimed or requested goods, and peace from a merciful lord prevent the exception from functioning as a simple ceiling on every positive gift. Deeds ground attribution and differentiation, while grace can exceed strict equivalence without wronging anyone.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal consequence supplies the baseline relation whose positive side is being tested for strict arithmetic.
Covering an offense and protecting its bearer from its effect supplies remission rather than bare equivalence.
The wage or return for work preserves a deed-linked basis for the promised good.
Honored generosity enlarges the wage image beyond minimal equivalence.
Tender mercy supplies the stated exception that preserves people when no rescue is available.
Claiming or calling for what is wanted supplies an open-ended beneficiary-side good.
Safety and freedom from harm supplies the culminating positive state.
Merciful tenderness identifies the source of that peace and keeps generosity inside the justice scene.

structural_cues: The early promise joins forgiveness to a generous wage, while the immediate post-focus sequence supplies desired goods and peace.
The exception to drowning in 36:44 is mercy, distinguishing gracious preservation from earned equivalence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deed-linked wage together with forgiveness, mercy, desired goods, and peace; I infer that the focus exception limits wrongful attribution more securely than it caps every benefit. A live alternative is that all listed goods are themselves exactly commensurate recompense.

changed_reading.before: Every outcome, good or bad, is numerically no more than the deed that earned it.
changed_reading.after: No adverse or differentiating outcome is falsely attributed, but the deed-grounded positive side may arrive through forgiveness and generous mercy rather than strict arithmetic alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior account writes what people sent ahead and their remaining traces, then enumerates every reportable thing. This expands the focus's work from momentary acts to attributable effects that persist beyond the act.

activation_trace.role: Purposive action remains the focus anchor whose temporal and causal extent is being expanded.
An inscription that establishes a binding judgment or determination supplies durable account registration.
Advancing something ahead supplies the direct acts sent before their agents.
A remaining mark that points back to what happened supplies propagated and enduring effects.
Every knowable, reportable item makes the record's scope coextensive with the focus's unrestricted object.
Counting by exhaustive enumeration supplies the mechanism that prevents an effect from being lost.

structural_cues: The coordinated objects of writing are what they advanced and their traces, followed by an all-things enumeration.
This recording statement precedes the focus and shares its unrestricted thing-expression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recorded direct advances, surviving traces, and exhaustive enumeration; I infer that recompensed work includes attributable aftereffects, not only the initiating gesture. A live alternative is that traces are recorded for another purpose and do not enlarge the recompense base.

changed_reading.before: What you did means only each completed, immediate act.
changed_reading.after: What you did includes the purposive act together with the attributable traces it set in motion and that the account preserves.

context_deltas.mechanism: Potential substitute routes are tested across the surah and fail: an intercessor cannot join itself to the threatened person effectively, no one extracts that person from danger, no answering rescuer responds, and adopted helpers become an assembled host rather than providers of aid. The focus's provenance-bound account is therefore operational, not merely grammatical.

activation_trace.role: One thing standing in another's place supplies the focus-side possibility of substitution.
A helper joining itself to another supplies the attempted intercessory route.
Extracting someone from a predicament or another's hand supplies the rescue that the attempted route cannot perform.
Answering a cry with aid supplies a second rescue channel that is explicitly absent.
Extraction from danger repeats as the unavailable result, making the failure structural.
Aid that makes its recipient prevail supplies the expected function of the adopted powers.
A mutually supporting host supplies the ironic collective form of those unable to help.
Presence and being brought near converts would-be helpers into fellow assembled subjects.

structural_cues: The same no-benefit and no-rescue pattern appears in 36:23, 36:43, and 36:74-75.
Would-be helpers end in the same brought-present posture used for the universal assembly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed intercession, rescue, and aid followed by shared presence; I infer that no external agent can take over the self's account. A live alternative is that these failures concern worldly protection only, while the focus itself leaves other mediation unaddressed.

changed_reading.before: The focus assigns deeds personally but leaves practical substitute routes open.
changed_reading.after: The surah repeatedly closes substitute routes: helpers cannot replace, extract, or discharge the self whose own work supplies the account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's what-you-worked formula is bracketed by fruit and what human hands worked, then by creatures made through divine hands and placed under human ownership. Work remains genuinely embodied and attributable, but it occurs inside received creation and provision, so its accountable quality includes how gifts are handled and acknowledged.

activation_trace.role: Purposive action anchors the repeated work formula whose agency relation changes.
The fruit as realized benefit supplies the material field in which human work appears.
Purposive work repeats in a construction closely matching the focus and links accountability to productive handling.
What hands earn supplies embodied provenance for the human side of work.
Recognizing a benefit and praising its giver assigns grateful response as the expected orientation of work.
Bringing creation into being supplies the prior productive agency within which human action operates.
The same purposive-work branch is assigned to divine hands, preventing work from being treated as an exclusively human possession.
The hand as bestowed benefit turns the created material into an entrusted gift.
Livestock as material wealth supplies the concrete object placed within human use.
Possession and power of disposal supplies the delegated control in which responsible action occurs.

structural_cues: The close verbal pattern around work and hands occurs at 36:35, 36:54, and 36:71.
Both provision passages end by testing human response: gratitude in 36:35 and again after the benefits listed in 36:73.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated work-hand constructions, created provision, possession, and gratitude; I infer nested agency in which human deeds are responsible uses of received materials. The live syntactic alternative in 36:35 is that human hands did not make the fruit, which would intensify rather than remove the dependence claim.

changed_reading.before: What you worked denotes self-originating deed units detached from their material conditions.
changed_reading.after: What you worked is embodied and truly yours, yet judged as a use or response within provision and productive powers you did not originate.

context_deltas.mechanism: A command to let allotted provision go outward is answered by refusing to feed and by relocating responsibility to divine will; later benefits again call for gratitude. Against the focus's withholding branch of wrong, what people worked includes purposive non-action that blocks a provision's social passage.

activation_trace.role: Withholding and confining a right anchors the focus in distributive harm.
Purposive action supplies the category into which a deliberate refusal may be read.
Money going out in expenditure supplies the requested outward movement of provision.
An apportioned gift supplies what is held and could be passed onward.
Covering over a benefit supplies the refusal's ingratitude and concealment mechanism.
Feeding another and requesting food supplies the concrete social act refused and reassigned.
Acknowledging benefit and its giver supplies the opposite response to concealed or hoarded provision.

structural_cues: The speakers answer an imperative to spend with a rhetorical refusal to feed, shifting the act to what God could have done.
The provision-benefit sequence later repeats the question of gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outgoing expenditure, allotted provision, refused feeding, covered benefit, and gratitude; I infer that a deliberate omission can belong to purposive work when it withholds a social due. A live alternative limits work to overt acts and treats the refusal only as accompanying speech.

changed_reading.before: Only overt deeds are returned, and no-wrong concerns the court's procedure.
changed_reading.after: The account can include deliberate withholding: justice answers not only what hands did, but the social good they purposively prevented from passing onward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenge asks when the promise will occur; after awakening, the speakers identify the event as the Merciful's promise and the messengers' truth. The focus's today is therefore the arrival of a previously marked appointment, and its no-wrong clause is also promise-keeping.

activation_trace.role: A bounded span or occasion supplies the deictic time whose identity the context resolves.
A promise fixed to a time or place supplies the questioned appointment.
A spoken promise that opens expectation supplies the now-recognized event.
Tender mercy identifies the promisor and prevents the appointment from being framed as sheer hostility.
Making a promise true in action supplies fulfillment rather than mere verbal correctness.
Messengers and message supply the prior communication now verified by arrival.

structural_cues: The when-question in 36:48 is answered by recognition in 36:52 and the deictic today in 36:54.
Promise and messenger-truth occur inside the same awakening-to-assembly sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a questioned appointment, its recognition as promised, and enacted truth immediately before today; I infer that 36:54 is the promise's performative arrival. A live alternative treats today as generic courtroom deixis without answering the earlier when.

changed_reading.before: Today is an isolated courtroom timestamp.
changed_reading.after: Today is the long-questioned appointment becoming present, so exact recompense also enacts the truth of the prior promise.

context_deltas.mechanism: One arresting cry interrupts live disputation, removes the chance to transmit a final instruction or return home, then the raised people rush out and are gathered into immediate presence. The focus stands exactly at the switch from alterable action to closed history: what you were doing is no longer editable and is now present for return.

activation_trace.role: Past occurrence fixes work as a completed temporal history once the switch has happened.
A terrifying cry supplies the abrupt transition signal.
Being seized on account of fault supplies the closure of ongoing disputation.
An instruction connected and handed on to another supplies the last action that can no longer be performed.
Returning to a former place supplies the unavailable route back into ordinary agency.
Rapid propulsion supplies the movement from graves toward the new scene.
Rousing what was still supplies the reactivation that does not reopen the prior work period.
Joining dispersed persons into one gathered whole supplies universal convergence.
Immediate presence and proximity supplies the completed delivery into accounting.

structural_cues: The ordered sequence is live dispute, sudden seizure, inability to make a final disposition or return, rapid emergence, and universal presence.
The focus opens with a consequential fa and today immediately after everyone is brought present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interruption, blocked final acts, irreversible departure, emergence, gathering, and presence; I infer a one-way phase change from mutable work to immutable record. A live alternative is that the sequence marks speed only and says nothing about closure of moral agency.

changed_reading.before: Past tense merely reports that deeds happened earlier.
changed_reading.after: The past wording marks a sealed action phase: one interruption turns ongoing life into a fixed history delivered immediately for recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, one group is constituted by companionship, a sheltered garden, absorbing occupation, and delight; then the other is commanded to separate as perpetrators. Recompense therefore materializes as social and spatial sorting into distinct modes of life, not only as quantities handed to isolated persons.

activation_trace.role: The individual self anchors the unit that is then placed into a differentiated collective condition.
Companionship and sustained association supply the positive group's relational form.
A garden sheltered by growth supplies that group's spatial environment.
Occupation as the opposite of vacancy supplies an absorbing mode of existence rather than a static prize.
Delight and agreeable well-being supplies the affective quality of that occupation.
Sorting until one thing is visibly distinct from another supplies the judgment's spatial operation.
Offense and culpable act supplies the basis naming the separated group.

structural_cues: The positive collective scene begins in the verse immediately after the focus; the command to separate follows four verses later and repeats today.
The text moves from universal selves to visibly differentiated communities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasting group labels, environments, occupations, affects, and an explicit sorting command; I infer that recompense is enacted as placement into fitting social worlds. A live alternative treats these as later consequences without making sorting part of the focus mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is an item transferred to each isolated individual.
changed_reading.after: Recompense also sorts selves into fitting relational, spatial, and affective worlds generated by their differing histories.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaking mouth is sealed while hands address the judge and feet testify about acquisition. The same body that performed and accumulated the work becomes its evidentiary surface, explaining how the focus's passive non-wrong avoids false self-report and mistaken attribution.

activation_trace.role: The self as the person's very identity supplies the whole whose organs become evidence.
Purposive action supplies what must be attributed without distortion.
A secured, preventing seal disables the ordinary channel of self-presentation.
The mouth as an opening supplies the channel that is closed.
Meaningful speech connecting interlocutors transfers testimony to the hands.
The hand as bodily organ supplies an executor of deeds that can now report them.
Making a statement from knowledge supplies the evidentiary function of the feet.
The foot or leg supplies the body's traveled and enacted record.
Acquisitive bodily instruments supply a bridge between what was gained and the organs that gained it.

structural_cues: The verse repeats today and a what-they-used-to construction, closely echoing the focus.
Agency and evidence are redistributed in sequence: mouth disabled, hands speaking, feet witnessing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sealed speech, speaking hands, witnessing feet, and acquired acts; I infer that bodily participation serves as self-authenticating evidence for exact attribution. A live alternative is that the scene only dramatizes omniscience and does not explain the focus's non-wrong mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Fairness is asserted without showing how contested deeds are assigned.
changed_reading.after: Fairness is evidentiary and embodied: the acting self carries a distributed record that can testify when strategic speech is disabled.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ج ز ز target bundled with focus ج ز ي and crosses into the surah's cultivation sequence. It remains anchored in the focus verb's supplied split inventory and in today as the moment of settlement, while seed, emergence, and fruit make maturation-to-cutting coherent. Downstream prose should call it a harvest-like activation, not claim that تُجْزَوْنَ lexically means cutting.

activation_trace.role: A decisive day-event supplies the harvest-like moment of conversion.
The alternate mapped root's time of cutting when growth is ripe supplies the deliberately form-distant harvest image.
Purposive action supplies what has developed toward the harvest-like outcome.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies manifestation of a previously hidden product.
A seed that grows and bears supplies the latent beginning of the result.
Ripe fruit supplies the matured endpoint ready to be gathered.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is an externally assigned payment after action.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, today is harvest: purposive work has grown into a manifest, ripe consequence that is now cut or gathered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it maps celestial motion onto adjudication. It remains anchored in the focus branch of putting nothing outside its proper place and is supported by measured courses in which one body does not overtake another. Downstream prose should present calibrated trajectories as a structural analogy for justice, not identify cosmic mechanics with the legal meaning.

activation_trace.role: Putting something outside its proper place supplies the focus-side prohibition on displacement.
A regular course or established way supplies stable trajectory.
Ordering by measure and considered determination supplies calibration.
A measure by which a thing reaches its bound supplies assigned stages.
Escaping or getting beyond a pursuer supplies the overtaking that the ordered scene denies.
A celestial course supplies the bounded track within which each motion remains.

changed_reading.before: No wrong means only that a judge avoids an unfair decision.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, no wrong is calibrated non-encroachment: each self and deed reaches its own measured course without another outcome overtaking or displacing it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it recasts recompense from a payment into a trajectory. It remains anchored in the focus's purposive work and reciprocal consequence, while the context repeatedly joins a straight path to movement, failed sight, inability to proceed, and inability to return. Downstream prose should describe consequence as path-like realization, not replace the ordinary recompense sense.

activation_trace.role: An act answered by its consequence anchors the path as realized return rather than an unrelated theme.
A worked, well-traveled road supplies an internal action-to-path bridge.
The straight road supplies the explicitly prescribed trajectory.
Straightness, balance, and evenness supply the road's norm.
Loss of sight supplies an inability to navigate the trajectory.
Racing ahead supplies attempted motion on the path.
The road repeats as the site where prior orientation becomes consequential.
Passing onward supplies the forward movement that can become unavailable.
Returning to what was supplies the reverse movement that is also closed.

changed_reading.before: Consequences are detached awards imposed after the road of action ends.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, recompense is the road becoming final: repeated orientations harden into the trajectory one can or cannot traverse.

strongest_changes: The account's object expands from isolated acts to direct advances plus their recorded, attributable traces.
The one-cry sequence turns today into a phase boundary where alterable action becomes closed history in immediate presence.
Speaking hands and witnessing feet make exact non-misassignment an embodied evidentiary mechanism.
The immediate garden and separation sequence realizes recompense as social and spatial sorting.
Forgiveness, mercy, generous wage, desired goods, and peace keep deed-based justice from collapsing into a purely positive arithmetic ceiling.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus operate as a hinge among repeated work-and-hand constructions, comprehensive recording, abrupt assembly, outcome sorting, and bodily testimony. Its split ج ز ي inventory also preserved a contained harvest activation, while measured celestial courses and traversed paths supplied two cross-domain models of non-displacement.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether recorded traces enlarge the recompense base or are only a parallel record remains inferential.
The exception may impose strict equivalence on all outcomes, only exclude alien attribution, or operate differently on adverse return and gracious benefit.
The syntactic force of the work-and-hands phrase in 36:35 remains live, although either major reading supports nested human agency.
The harvest, calibrated-course, and realized-path models are structurally anchored but should remain explicitly metaphorical and exploratory.
